units: <cite ref="Mishnah Maasrot 3:9">Maasr. III, 9</cite> <he>מְקַרְטֵם עלה וכ׳</he> he may pluck leaf by leaf and eat (without tithing); Y. ib. 50ᶜ; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Kamma 2:2:2">Y. B. Kam. II, 3ᵃ</cite> top <he>וקִירְטְמוּ החילפין</he> and they (the chickens) ruined the young shoots; (<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Kamma 2:1">Tosef. ib. II, 1</cite> <he>וקִיטְּמוּ</he>). Y’lamd. to Num. XXII, 4 quot. in Ar. <he>כל בהמה מְקַרְטֶמֶת אחד אחד וכ׳</he> any other beast on pasture plucks one part of the field after the other, but the ox &c.
